The table lists every atom of one conventional cell (cell parameters in the first line of the table) of Pentacalcium tris(phosphate(V)) hydroxide (Ca5 H O13 P3, COD 7217892) as fractional coordinates. Use the kinematic structure factor F(hkl) = Σ_j Z_j exp[2πi(h x_j + k y_j + l z_j)] with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights (Ca = 20, O = 8, P = 15). Exactly one of the four reflections below has |F| = 0. Which one?

选项：
A. (2 0 0)
B. (0 0 3)
C. (0 0 2)
D. (1 0 2)
